newsitem.title: USA: IMM currency futures end lower,except marks, pesos.
newsitem.headline: IMM currency futures end lower,except marks, pesos.

text.p: May 22 - IMM currency futures closed lower, except for marks and pesos. Pesos shrug off losses. June marks ended with slim gains due to cash mark/Swiss franc rebound. SNB held discount rate steady. Minutes from March 25 FOMC show they voted 10-0 to adopt symmetric policy directive between meetings. ((Derivatives desk 312-408-8750))
